Q11: Among all the films submitted for the Best International Feature Film category, only 2 were in the Hindi language. One was, of course, Homebound, which reached the 15-film shortlist.
The other movie was submitted by X as its first-ever Oscar submission. Announced by the X Oscar Selection Committee during the country’s 50th independence anniversary, the film holds cultural significance. This movie is the first X-India co-produced feature film, directed by the 3-time National Film Award winner Malayalam director Dr Biju. The film follows an elderly war veteran who helps 2 Indian historians discover forgotten World War II events that link India and X through acts of bravery and kindness.
This is a multilingual film featuring X's official language, Hindi, English, and Bengali.
